findings.ac: npm test still runs offline with no credentials
findings.text: No assertion runs or models the default suite without credentials; the only evidence is the static check in BT170_DriftGuardCli.test.js that pkg.scripts.test === 'vitest run' and that the CLI script filename is not *.test.*. A network-calling test added to the default suite, or one needing SUPABASE_* env, would not fail any test.

findings.ac: Cron pre-flight exit status distinguishable from infrastructure failure
findings.text: Process-level exit status is asserted only for divergence (BT170_CronPreflight.test.js child-process test expects code 3). The unreachable case (exit 4) is asserted only on the in-process return value (result.exitCode), not on the real exit of scripts/run-job-ingestion.js, so a regression in the CLI wrapper (process.exitCode = res.exitCode) for the 4 path would go undetected; a maintainer reading the exit alone is the stated AC.

findings.ac: Stress S5/S6 / edge 21: credential absent -> distinct infrastructure message, not divergence
findings.text: The 'hard-fails as misconfiguration' CLI test asserts only /MISCONFIGURATION/, not SKIPPED, and exit 4; it does not assert /INFRASTRUCTURE/ or not.toMatch(/DIVERGED/) as the unreachable test does, so a message that merged the divergence wording would still pass. The unset-DRIFT_GUARD_FORK_PR case (local run) and a half-set credential (URL without key) are also never exercised.

findings.ac: Time-to-Value: red build naming the offending value on the same push
findings.text: CI test only regex-checks the step's env block and the 'run: npm run test:drift' line; it does not assert the step is blocking (no continue-on-error) or reachable. ci.yml push trigger is limited to main, feat/*, fix/*, test/* so pushes to other branch types (e.g. improvement/*) get no red build until a PR exists, and nothing tests this.
